Imported lexicon attribution and license

Source: English Wiktionary contributors, extracted by Wiktextract and distributed
by Tatu Ylonen / Kaikki.org.
https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Azerbaijani/index.html
https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights

The imported and adapted dictionary material in lexicon.js is made available
under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International license:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Attribution for each entry: https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/HEADWORD#Azerbaijani
where HEADWORD is the entry's source headword, stored as metadata.head.
The corresponding page's History tab lists its contributors. Forms link to their
headword, where their declension table is documented. The app links each imported
entry to that source. No endorsement by Wiktionary or Kaikki is implied.

Adaptations: Latin-script filtering; omission of names, affixes and unsupported
scripts; deduplication; selection of up to five senses; explicit lexical links;
selected plural/locative/ablative forms from the source tables; compact data layout;
Azerbaijani explanatory labels for morphology. English glosses are not presented
as Azerbaijani translations. Quoted examples were not imported.

Snapshot and SHA-256: see lexicon-attribution.json.
This notice covers imported dictionary material, not the separate user-supplied
data.js collection or the site's application code.

Supplemental vocabulary and grammar views (November 2026)

vocabulary.js also adapts Azerbaijani entries by the contributors to Turkish and
Russian Wiktionary, extracted by Wiktextract and distributed by Kaikki:
https://kaikki.org/trwiktionary/Azerice/index.html
https://kaikki.org/ruwiktionary/Азербайджанский/index.html
https://tr.wiktionary.org/wiki/Vikisözlük:Telif_hakları
https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/Викисловарь:Авторские_права

This adapted material is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0, as linked above. Each entry stores
its edition and source headword; attribution is https://EDITION.wiktionary.org/wiki/HEADWORD
and that page's History tab. See vocabulary-attribution.json for snapshot dates
and SHA-256 hashes. Additional adaptations: lowercase Latin headwords only;
deduplication against the existing collection; omission of explicit inflections,
alternative forms, archaic/obsolete senses and non-infinitive verbs; source-language
glosses retained and labeled; documented lexical connections only.

grammar.js and grammar-archive.json separate verb-inflection senses from lexical
senses without modifying data.js or lexicon.js. Negative infinitives are archived;
derived passive/causative infinitives remain in the main dictionary. Homonymous
nouns, adjectives and other independent lexical senses are retained. Selected
explicit conjugation-table entries are included in the archive. Source-language
glosses and grammatical tags are retained; the archive is not a complete grammar.
grammar-archive.json also preserves the original associated rows and relationships.
Source attribution and CC BY-SA 4.0 apply to the imported parts of this archive.

Additional vocabulary and relationship review (November 2026)

review.js additionally adapts Azerbaijani entries by the contributors to French,
German and Kurdish Wiktionary, under CC BY-SA 4.0:
https://kaikki.org/frwiktionary/Azéri/index.html
https://kaikki.org/dewiktionary/Aserbaidschanisch/index.html
https://kaikki.org/kuwiktionary/Azerî/index.html

Per-entry attribution uses the stored edition and headword at
https://EDITION.wiktionary.org/wiki/HEADWORD (and that page's History tab).
541 new English-glossed terms come from explicit derived/related-term listings;
they link to the source entry containing that listing. Additional filtering
excludes negative infinitives, verb inflections listed in conjugation tables,
explicit obsolete/archaic/alternative forms and unsupported scripts.

Adaptations also retain per-relationship sense/register information and apply
11 documented editorial corrections and a reviewed temporal-sense family.
No global transitive closure is applied. The original imported files are preserved.
See relationship-audit.json for source hashes, versions, references and corrections.

Bilingual display layer (November 2026)

bilingual.js translates the imported dictionary senses into Azerbaijani and English
using cached Google Translate and AI-assisted translations, with a separate set of edited
bilingual definitions. Original Wiktionary edition/headword attribution remains
on each entry and source files are unchanged. The translations are adaptations
of the CC BY-SA 4.0 dictionary material and are distributed under that license.
See bilingual-attribution.json for coverage, method, date and the cache SHA-256.
The application performs no runtime translation requests. Machine-translated
primary entries are marked; this is not a linguist-verified dictionary edition.

Editorial vocabulary and learning content (2026-11-14)
----------------------------------------------------
expansion.js adds 795 distinct lexical entries with newly authored Azerbaijani
and English definitions. These AI-assisted editorial definitions and the quiz
clues in learning-data.js are provided under CC BY-SA 4.0. References recorded
in expansion-attribution.json document selected spelling and terminology checks;
the definitions do not reproduce those reference works. No complete professional
linguistic review is claimed. New graph links indicate topic only. The earlier
dictionary data and grammar archive are unchanged.

Nominal form separation (2026-11-14)
------------------------------------
nominal.js and nominal-archive.json separate documented grammatical inflections
from lexical headwords using the same English Wiktionary snapshot recorded in
lexicon-attribution.json. Original source rows, relationships, senses and tags
are preserved. Bilingual form explanations are templated adaptations of these
analyses. Independent lexical senses use the existing translation layer plus
three supplemental AI-assisted translations. Explicit source corrections and
headword counts are recorded in word-count.json and the reproducible scripts.
These adaptations are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 with Wiktionary attribution.
The earlier data files and 991-record verb archive are unchanged.

Persistent atlas (2026-11-14)
-----------------------------
The editorial navigation taxonomy and computed coordinates in galaxy-data.js
are adaptations for exploring the existing dictionary collection. They do not
add synonym, root or etymology assertions. The original dictionary relationship
and attribution layers remain unchanged. See galaxy-attribution.json for method
coverage, limitations and source hash. The taxonomy and atlas data are provided
under CC BY-SA 4.0 alongside the existing dictionary adaptations.

2026-11-14 gathering update: 567 new single-word headwords in additions.js, with original AI-assisted Azerbaijani and English definitions, CC BY-SA 4.0. Only topic connections were added. Five spelling variants were excluded. See additions-attribution.json for method, limited terminology checks and preservation hashes. No original data, grammatical archives, daily sequence or quiz content were changed. Galaxy coordinates from the previous atlas are retained exactly; close-up gathering uses temporary display positions.

2026-11-17 vocabulary and root-family expansion
------------------------------------------------
growth.js adds 617 distinct lexical entries with Azerbaijani and English glosses,
from Spanish, Polish, Portuguese, Greek, Korean, Chinese and Azerbaijani
Wiktionary editions. Wiktionary contributors retain attribution under CC BY-SA
4.0; per-entry source URLs and native-page revision IDs are recorded in
growth-attribution.json. Native glosses are short newly authored paraphrases.
Other glosses are machine-assisted translations, with explicit editorial fixes.
The same file documents 1,748 reviewed root families, compound leaf memberships,
sense-specific semantic decisions, held source errors and one corrected earlier
definition. Root siblings share a lexical base but need not derive directly from
one another. Topic associations do not assert synonymy. The original dictionary
layers and grammar archives are preserved. This is a source-assisted expansion,
not a claim that every sense and relation has received professional validation.
The editorial adaptations and new paraphrases are shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.

2026-11-17 dictionary and relationship audit
------------------------------------------
verification.js is an additive editorial correction layer. Each changed entry
has short Azerbaijani and English paraphrases and source citations in
verification-attribution.json; verification-report.html explains the scope,
changes and unresolved cases. Wiktionary adaptations retain contributor
attribution under CC BY-SA 4.0. New editorial explanations are also CC BY-SA 4.0.
The 2006 four-volume Azərbaycan dilinin izahlı lüğəti and other dictionary
references were consulted to compare factual senses; their full entries,
extracted database and book prose are not redistributed. Comparisons are
AI-assisted, sense-specific and not a professional linguistic certification.
Original source layers and grammar archives remain preserved.
